references.text: David expresses a deep sorrow in his soul, which reflects Jesus' feelings in Gethsemane.
David asks why his soul is troubled, which reflects Jesus' deep sorrow.
Repetition of David's feeling of deep sorrow, parallel to Jesus' feelings.
Paul speaks about carrying the death of Jesus in our bodies, which can be related to Jesus' suffering.
Refers to Jesus' prayers and supplications with a loud voice and tears, showing his deep sorrow.
